coverage.reason: Recover failed Friends/Messages startup using one account-scoped request, bounded backoff, chat reopen/visibility/online events and cancellable logout cleanup. Real browser cases reproduce missing tabs after initial failure; verify retry, backend disabled capability, concurrent starts, stale-account completion, failed-list reload and unchanged shared chat layouts across desktop/landscape/mobile. Existing chat and private notification tests protect shared tab lifecycle, unread and alert behavior; asset budgets keep the recovery code bounded. No backend, schema, social permissions or gameplay changes; no emulator suite is affected.
